components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA with neumorphic glow and press feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #416375; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Aspekta, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28), 0 10px 24px rgba(65,99,117,0.28), -4px -4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.92); transition: filter 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.32), 0 13px 28px rgba(65,99,117,0.34), -5px -5px 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.92); filter: brightness(1.05); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #416375; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Chat Input
components.description: Pill-shaped composer with inset shadow and thinking-state animation.
components.css: .ds-chat-input { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; background: #f4f3f5; border: 1px solid #f0f0ec; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(174,174,174,0.15), inset -2px -2px 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.7); padding: 8px 12px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chat-input:focus-within { border-color: #416375; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(105,112,116,0.17), inset -3px -3px 9px rgba(255,255,255,0.92), 0 0 0 2px rgba(65,99,117,0.28); } .ds-chat-input input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; flex: 1; font-family: Aspekta, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1a1c1d; } .ds-chat-input input::placeholder { color: #5c6367; } .ds-send-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #416375; color: #fff; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(65,99,117,0.3); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-send-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-send-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview:
Reogent's interface is a precision instrument rendered in soft matte material. Every surface is molded from the same substance — gently dimensional, functional, quietly confident. The neumorphic treatment creates depth through sculpted shadow rather than transparency or decoration. Controls feel pressable. Panels feel lifted. The whole system reads as a single material shaped into different forms for different purposes.

This is modern neumorphism that learned from the excesses of 2020: shadows are warm and diffuse, not dramatic. The glass-material overlays add translucency only where it serves spatial hierarchy (the header floating over content, panels layering over the map). Depth communicates function — recessed means input, raised means action, flat means content.

The dual-shadow architecture is intentional: basic elevation tokens provide a Tailwind-compatible utility layer, while the refined neumorphic system handles composed surfaces with multi-shadow recipes. A radial-gradient canvas behind everything gives the "table" warmth and subtle spatial cues.
keyCharacteristics: Molded and tactile — every element feels pressable, shaped from a single soft material
Content-forward — chat messages and map data are the product; the neumorphic frame never competes
Dual-layer shadow — utility-level elevation tokens coexist with refined composed neumorphic shadows
Glass as hierarchy — backdrop-blur materials appear only where layering serves function
Warm shadows — tinted with warm gray in light mode, never pure black

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Neumorphic shadows in light mode use rgba(174,174,174,x) — never pure black. In dark mode, shadows shift to rgba(0,0,0,x) with highlights at rgba(65,66,72,0.48).

rules.name: The Muted-for-AA Rule
rules.body: Where the design calls for subdued text, use --muted (#5c6367) instead of --outline or --outline-variant, which fail WCAG AA contrast on the light surface hierarchy.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Emphasis uses weight 500–550, never 700+. Only structural headings go to 600.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a structured identifier (CPSC 110, 14:30, ICCS) renders in Commit Mono.

rules.name: The Dual-Tier Rule
rules.body: Tier 1 (elevation utilities) is for quick assignments in markup. Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) is for composed surfaces. Never mix them on the same element.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: The implied light source is always upper-left. Shadows fall bottom-right, highlights sit top-left. Every .neu-* class has inset 0 1px 0 var(--neu-edge) to reinforce this.

dos: Do use .neu-panel / .neu-raised / .neu-inset for composed surfaces — they carry the full edge-highlight + multi-shadow recipe.
Do use --muted for placeholder and meta text to maintain WCAG AA contrast.
Do apply border border-border-subtle alongside every neumorphic shadow — the border anchors the edge highlight.
Do use --neu-ease (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for panel animations — it gives the 'molded' feel of elements settling into place.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — all animations collapse to instant, reveal elements show immediately.
Do use [data-theme="dark"] for theme switching, not prefers-color-scheme media query.
donts: Don't mix Tier 1 (Tailwind shadow utilities) and Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) on the same element.
Don't use pure black in shadows — warm gray in light mode, deep neutral in dark mode.
Don't add backdrop-filter to elements that don't need layering hierarchy — glass is for panels that float over other content, not for everything.
Don't use --outline or --outline-variant for text that must pass AA contrast on light surfaces — use --muted instead.
Don't apply neumorphic depth to text content itself — depth frames the content, the content stays flat and readable.
Don't animate shadow values directly (GPU-expensive) — animate transform and switch shadow classes via state.
